data.body: ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence, empirically reproduced): _phase_staged_intermediate re-points BRANCH to staged at merge-to-main-pr.sh:994 but calls undefined _state_write_branch (no-op) instead of _state_init, so the staged-keyed state file is never created on the fresh path; _state_write_pr_meta no-ops on its [[ -f ]] guard, PR2 number never persisted, polling read empty -> error line 3009. --resume works (re-invokes _state_init at line 2885). Fix: replace dead _state_write_branch call with _state_init + re-set staged_branch; add gh pr list fallback in polling block (defense-in-depth + self-heals open PR2s). testing_mode=RED.
